name: Deviz general and its chapters
review_status: Chapter structure read from a completed HG 907/2016 deviz general published by a Romanian county council. Pending review by a Romanian cost engineer.
references: HG 907/2016 privind etapele de elaborare și conținutul-cadru al documentațiilor tehnico-economice aferente obiectivelor/proiectelor de investiții finanțate din fonduri publice (https://legislatie.just.ro/public/detaliidocument/185166)
description: A publicly funded investment in Romania is budgeted in a deviz general of six chapters, each split into subchapters, and every object in it has its own deviz pe obiect. The chapter a cost sits in decides how it is financed, approved and audited, so a line whose chapter cannot be read is a line the client cannot place. The pack classifies each line against DIN 276 for the cost-group view and files it under its deviz general chapter as well.

chapters.1: Cheltuieli pentru obținerea și amenajarea terenului
chapters.2: Cheltuieli pentru asigurarea utilităților necesare obiectivului de investiții
chapters.3: Cheltuieli pentru proiectare și asistență tehnică
chapters.6: Cheltuieli pentru probe tehnologice și teste

practice_notes: Construction and installation works of an object sit in subchapter 4.1, site organisation in 5.1, and the contingency (cheltuieli diverse și neprevăzute) in 5.3
The contractor's tender (deviz ofertă) is priced from norme de deviz: the Indicatoare de norme de deviz give the material, labour and plant consumption per unit of work

CAM, the 2.25 percent employer's labour insurance contribution (Codul fiscal art. 220^3), is levied on the labour component alone and sits inside the labour cost of each position rather than as a percentage of the bill
